In the MoonWise app you will find forecasts for the Void of Course Moon. Unlike weather forecasts, which can only predict upcoming periods with high probability, Void of Course Moon periods are calculated mathematically and depend on the Moon's movement in Earth's orbit. This way, you can find out the time of the Void of Course Moon for weeks in advance and plan your activities accordingly.

The simple and intuitive interface of the MoonWise app will help you quickly determine whether the Moon is currently out of course, and check whether it will be in this state on the date you select.
